title: The Dataset Nutrition Label (2nd Gen): Leveraging Context to Mitigate Harms in Artificial Intelligence
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on a general framework for dataset transparency and bias mitigation, with examples focusing on domains like public health, housing, and medical imaging, and demographic categories like race and gender.

measurement_description: The paper does not benchmark or measure anything related to faith or religion. It proposes a framework ('Dataset Nutrition Label') for evaluating datasets for general harms and biases, not models.
